dbToolScopingDenylist.customers: Synthetic contacts for the single shared demo shop; not workspace member identities. Access through ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.products: Shared synthetic demo catalog, independent of workspace membership. Access through ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.orders: Synthetic single-shop purchase snapshots shared by operators. Mutations use the transactional ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.shipments: Synthetic single-shop delivery records. Writes serialize with the transactional ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.requests: Synthetic support inbox for the single shared demo shop. Access through ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.refunds: Synthetic single-shop refund history. Mutations use the transactional ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.replies: Stored synthetic demo replies, not external mail or member-owned messages. Access through ShopRepository.
